title: Welcome back
content: It's been months since I have visited mallworld. I've been going through some stuff in my awake life and I woke up today so happy to have visited again. It felt like a warm hug to see the escalators and all the shops. It's calming to know that nothing changed, the smell, the low murmur of voices, the squeaking of shoes on the floors. I just needed to share with people who understand.
